name: @anywalletkit/seed-vault
description: Encrypted backups of wallet secrets for Any Wallet Kit: a versioned, self-describing envelope (XChaCha20-Poly1305 under a random data key) that one or more protectors unlock — a password through Argon2id, or a 32-byte key from a passkey PRF, an iCloud Keychain / Block Store item or a hardware key. Metadata (type, fingerprint) is authenticated, nothing is logged, every key is zeroized, decode is strict and bounded. Pure TypeScript, Hermes-safe; the native Argon2 hook makes it fast on phones.
